games.title: Retro Snake 2000
games.description: Classic retro snake with smooth responsive controls, golden apples, and high-score tracking.
games.instructions: Guide the hungry snake to eat glowing apples. Avoid running into the perimeter walls or your own tail!

games.title: Neon Pong Rivals
games.description: Fast-paced table tennis with responsive physics, computer AI rival or local 2-player mode.
games.instructions: Deflect the glowing neon ball past your opponent. The first player to reach 7 points wins the championship!

games.title: Block Breaker DX
games.description: Vibrant breakout game with power-ups, multiple tiers of brick hardness, and combo scoring.
games.instructions: Bounce the steel ball to shatter every brick. Catch power capsules for extended paddles and multiballs!

games.title: Space Defender: Orbital War
games.description: Defend planet Earth from descending alien invasion fleets with rapid-fire lasers and energy shields.
games.instructions: Maneuver your starship across the lower deck and blast incoming alien armadas before they breach orbit!

games.title: Flappy Helicopter
games.description: Tap or hold to guide your agile chopper through hazardous neon pillars and conquer the leaderboards.
games.instructions: Press Space, click, or tap to elevate altitude. Thread through narrow pipes without clipping edges!

games.title: 2048 Neon Pulse
games.description: Slide numbers together to combine twin tiles and strive for the elusive 2048 milestone.
games.instructions: Use Arrow Keys or WASD to slide all tiles in one direction. Identical numbers merge into their sum!

games.title: Minesweeper Classic
games.description: Uncover hidden minefields using deductive logic and numeric proximity clues.
games.instructions: Click tiles to uncover. Right-click or toggle Flag mode to mark suspected mines.
